stem: The organization’s parlous fiscal condition led its members to expect that their plans for expansion would be ____.
This artistic and literary movement reflected a widespread nihilistic protest against every aspect of Western culture and thus ____ the particular aesthetic values of that culture.
She may have been (i)____ when she was finance minister, fighting deficits, but now as prime minister she is marked by her (ii)____.

Some recent research shows that people tend to (i)____ advice from (ii)____ source, even to the point that we are willing to forgive an adviser's poor track record. This can drive those offering advice to (iii)____ and bodes ill for advisers who try to be honest about gaps in their knowledge.
The fact that no single Cantonese dictionary is seen as ____ is one of the main reasons why most Hong Kong authors do not depend on formal reference tools when writing in Cantonese.

Because connections made of the material are ____ to fail at high temperatures, it is particularly suited for sacrificial thermal cutoff switches; it is, of course, unsuited to applications where heat durability is needed.
On close reading, the poem comes across as ____, devoid of any real interest or substance.
